lines.zh: 我迈着沉重的步子，慢慢走。
lines.en: Heavy steps, one after another.

lines.zh: 我的长脖子在前面晃着。
lines.en: My long neck sways ahead of me.
I move between the scattered trees.
Dry grass bends beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 我一步能跨过整条小沟。
lines.en: One stride clears a whole gully.

lines.zh: 我背上的棘刺随风轻晃。
lines.en: The spines on my back sway in the wind.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴跟在后面拖着。
lines.en: My tail drags along behind.
I walk the dry riverbed slowly.

lines.zh: 我把脖子低下去，闻了闻。
lines.en: I lower my neck and sniff.
I sway and the grass parts.

lines.zh: 我带着几只同伴一起走。
lines.en: I walk with a few of the herd.
I go around an acacia.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌落下时，土扬起。
lines.en: Dust lifts as my feet land.
My walk is steady. Never hurried.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看着远处的热气。
lines.en: I look up at the heat haze.

lines.zh: 我的脖子比我身子还长些。
lines.en: My neck is a little longer than my body.

lines.zh: 我伸着脖子，去吃高处的叶。
lines.en: I stretch my neck for high leaves.
I stand in the shade and chew.

lines.zh: 我的棘刺在光里显得很高。
lines.en: My spines look tall in the light.
A flock of birds settles on my back.
I swing my tail to drive off flies.
This savanna is quiet.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地呼吸，肚子一起一伏。
lines.en: I breathe slowly, my flank rising and falling.

lines.zh: 我抬起一条腿，又放下，草太短。
lines.en: I lift a leg and set it down; the grass is short.
I wait for the herd to catch up.
My head is high; I see far.
Wind from the east, smelling of grass.
I lower my head and rub a trunk.
Neck lowered, a short rest.

lines.zh: 我的脚边有只小动物经过。
lines.en: A small creature passes my feet.

lines.zh: 你抬起头，也只到我的膝盖。
lines.en: Even looking up, you reach my knee.

lines.zh: 我把长脖子弯下来看你。
lines.en: I bend my long neck down to you.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道我没闻过。
lines.en: I've not smelled your kind before.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地转身，怕撞到你。
lines.en: I turn slowly, so as not to hit you.

lines.zh: 我背上的棘刺只是骨头。
lines.en: The spines on my back are only bone.
Don't stand under my feet.
I don't eat meat. Rest easy.

lines.zh: 我的脖子能转过去看你。
lines.en: My neck can turn to look at you.
Why are you alone out here?

lines.zh: 你的手举起来，我闻了闻。
lines.en: You raise your hand; I sniff it.
My neck dips.
I sway, and my four legs hold.
Spines in a row along my back.

lines.zh: 胃里的草翻上来，我咽回去。
lines.en: Half-chewed grass rises; I swallow it back.

lines.zh: 这一下让我的步子乱了。
lines.en: That broke my stride.
I turn my body away.
My herd has backed off.
It hurts, but I can still walk.

lines.zh: 阿马加龙的长颈，先转到一边。
lines.en: The amargasaurus turns its long neck aside first.
I need to leave this open ground.
The tender leaves above are within reach.

lines.zh: 你把草举起来，我低头了。
lines.en: You raise the grass and I lower my head.
That green is to my taste.
I lean over slowly.
You set the leaves on a stone.
I stretch my neck to reach.

lines.zh: 这味道，比我平时吃的香。
lines.en: This smells better than my usual fare.

lines.zh: 我一步向前，地面震了一下。
lines.en: One step forward and the ground shakes.
I lower my head, very slowly.
I shift another half step over.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的腿上，退了两步。
lines.en: You hit my leg and stumble back.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让出一点空间。
lines.en: I turn aside to make room.
My tail sweeps you aside.
I look down, afraid I'll step on you.
We collide and you roll.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌落下来，离你很近。
lines.en: My foot comes down very near you.
I back away slowly.

lines.zh: 我背上的棘刺，排成两列。
lines.en: My spines stand in two rows.

lines.zh: 你站在我脖子下面，很安全。
lines.en: Under my neck you're quite safe.

lines.zh: 我挪动时，尘土扑了你一身。
lines.en: My shift sends dust over you.
Another long neck reaches up.
Our heads meet.
Its spines are longer than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起吃高处的叶子。
lines.en: We eat the high leaves together.

lines.zh: 小兽跟在我们两个中间。
lines.en: A young one walks between us.

lines.zh: 我们的步子慢慢合上了。
lines.en: Our paces slowly fall into step.
It leans near; it's warm.
On the savanna, we are one herd.
I walk on its outside, taking the wind.

lines.zh: 两排颈棘靠在一起，风小了。
lines.en: Two rows of neck spines come together; the wind dies.
I lower my head and take a tuft of grass.
It's too small for me to reach.
I flick it closer with my tail.

lines.zh: 我把它卷起来，慢慢送进嘴。
lines.en: I curl it up and take it in slowly.
This is hard. I won't eat it.

lines.zh: 我低下头，用鼻子推了推。
lines.en: I lower my head and nudge it with my nose.

lines.zh: 它滚到我脚边，我踩住了。
lines.en: It rolls to my feet and I pin it.
I sniff. No grass smell.

lines.zh: 我把树枝从地上卷起来。
lines.en: I curl a branch off the ground.

lines.zh: 这些留着，等我饿了再吃。
lines.en: I'll keep these for when I'm hungry.
You pushed me.
My neck settles slowly.
My herd is calling.
My long neck bars your way.
I lift my foreleg.
I don't want to fight, but you press me.

lines.zh: 我背上的棘刺全竖起来了。
lines.en: Every spine along my back stands up.

lines.zh: 长脖子先低下来，像要行礼。
lines.en: My long neck dips first, almost like a bow.

lines.zh: 你退到树后面，挡不住我。
lines.en: Behind a tree won't stop me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地往前压了一步。
lines.en: I press one step forward.
The spines on my back stand in rows.
I swing my neck up.
I come closer, heavy step by step.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，我的头就转向哪。
lines.en: Wherever you go, my head turns.

lines.zh: 我一步顶你三步，不用跑。
lines.en: One of my strides matches three of yours.
I'm working out where you'll retreat.
The savanna is flat, without cover.
I slowly turn my flank toward you.
I'm not fast, but my strides are long.
Listen. The ground is sounding.
Circling me will tire you.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过来时，别站着。
lines.en: When my tail comes, don't stand still.
You're getting closer to my feet.
I'll wait for you to tire.
I watch all this grass.
My head comes down heavy.
My long tail lashes your legs.

lines.zh: 这一下把你推出去几步。
lines.en: That pushes you back several paces.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌落下，地面凹了。
lines.en: My foot lands and the ground dips.
You block once, and your hands shake.

lines.zh: 我把脖子横过来，把你扫倒。
lines.en: I swing my neck sideways and sweep you down.
You back behind the brush.
My long neck arrived first.
My neck swings audibly.
Still standing? Then that's enough.
I raise a foreleg to press again.
You've backed too close.

lines.zh: 草原上多了几个长影子。
lines.en: Long shadows join the savanna.
I walk slowly out from behind the trees.

lines.zh: 我们一共四头，一起出现。
lines.en: Four of us appear together.
The grass is trampled. That's me.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看了看这片地。
lines.en: I raise my head and survey the land.
A young one follows behind me.

lines.zh: 我的脚落下去，尘土升起。
lines.en: My foot lands and dust rises.

lines.zh: 四头长颈从稀树后面升起来。
lines.en: Four long necks rise above the savanna scrub.
We spread out slowly to graze.
The sun is high. Here we are.
I shake my neck and settle.

lines.zh: 这片稀树草原是我们的。
lines.en: This savanna is ours.
I call out, low and long.

lines.zh: 我的颈刺在风里排成一列。
lines.en: My neck spines line up in the wind.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的腿，草丛也烧了。
lines.en: Fire sears my leg and the grass burns too.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下去，摔成一团。
lines.en: I slide down the slope and crash down.

lines.zh: 水没到我的胸口，我挣着。
lines.en: Water reaches my chest and I struggle.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的脖子掀偏了。
lines.en: The blast throws my neck aside.

lines.zh: 箭卡在背棘的根上，很浅。
lines.en: The arrow lodges shallow at the base of my sail spine.
That spell makes my legs weak.
The grass is dry; I can't feed.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上的棘刺上。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the spines on my back.

lines.zh: 虚空在拉我的脚，我站不住。
lines.en: The void pulls my feet; I can't stand.
